limitations: Labels are traceable to the published split CSVs only; the clinical tables behind them were not available.
SR386 labels encode MMR protein loss and SR1482 labels encode MSI/dMMR; the combined endpoint mixes two assays.
Agreement between sources shows consistent copies of one publication, not clinical correctness.
Eligible records are provisional until every WSI is present, hashed and checked for duplicate content.
The test partition was used for historical evaluation and EDA; it is a reused benchmark, not a fresh hold-out.
That SR386 and SR1482 case numbers denote disjoint patients is inferred, not verifiable without clinical identifiers.
